basecamp._comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in. Personal access tokens come from https://launchpad.37signals.com/integrations. The user_id is the numeric id of YOUR Basecamp account, find it in your profile URL.

filters._comment: Per-user overrides on top of the built-in newsletter rules. Domains match subdomains too (scaleupmedia.com drops reply.scaleupmedia.com). Allowlist wins over droplist wins over heuristics.

writing._comment: Extra brief writing rules beyond the universal no-em-dash pass (which is always on). All OFF by default. Enable only the brand-voice rules you want.

metrics._comment: Custom external metrics. Each command should print a single value to stdout. Render as a blockquote at the top of the brief. Default metrics (Basecamp open todos) ship with no config.
metrics.label: Example custom metric

sync._comment: Tier 5 sync targets. All default OFF. Enable per-target by setting `enabled: true`. Each is idempotent within a day. Run `node scripts/unsync.mjs --date YYYY-MM-DD` to roll back.

notion._comment: Either parent_page_id (creates child pages) OR database_url (creates rows). Get the ID from the URL of the parent page in Notion: notion.so/workspace/Title-<page_id_no_dashes>.

calendar._comment: Auto-create a 'Deep work: <One Thing>' event today. Defaults to the next 25-min slot for 90 min in the first writable calendar. Override with calendar_name / start / minutes.

reminders._comment: Push slow-burn + 48h-deadline + aged-promise items into Apple Reminders. List auto-created if missing.
